free_tier.stated: AI Free: USD 0 with unlimited AI completion in JetBrains IDEs and 3 AI credits every 30 days, one AI credit being USD 1.00 of AI use, with no top-up and no rollover; paid plans are AI Pro, USD 100 a year for 10 credits every 30 days, and AI Ultimate, USD 300 a year for 35 credits every 30 days
free_tier.notes: credits are spent at the model vendor's public API rate, so the number of tasks that 3 credits buy depends on the agent and model; the page publishes no credits-per-task figure

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters AI use, not objects

interface_detail: Junie CLI (junie, Linux, macOS and Windows) runs interactively and headless; Claude Agent, Codex, Gemini CLI and Junie also run in the AI chat of a JetBrains IDE and in the JetBrains Air app; JetBrains Central CLI connects Claude Agent, Codex, Gemini CLI and Junie CLI to the JetBrains AI subscription from a terminal
tooling: the user installs Junie CLI with a curl or PowerShell install script, or a JetBrains IDE with the AI Assistant plugin, or JetBrains Central CLI; AI Free is offered in JetBrains IDEs except Android Studio, IntelliJ IDEA without Ultimate and PyCharm without Pro
chaining: Junie CLI headless takes a Junie API key (usage-based billing) with --auth or a licence key with --auth-license, and JetBrains Central CLI routes Claude Agent, Codex and Gemini CLI to the JetBrains AI subscription and offers service accounts for headless and CI use; whether an AI Free or AI Pro licence qualifies for Central CLI access is not stated. Bring-your-own-key and provider-account routes (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, GitHub Copilot) bypass JetBrains credits and bill the provider

limits.value: AI Free 3 AI credits every 30 days, AI Pro 10, AI Ultimate 35; one AI credit is USD 1.00 of AI use; unused credits do not roll over; top-up credits (AI Pro and AI Ultimate only) stay valid 12 months

limits_note: AI Free has no top-up, so it ends at 3 credits a month
binding_note: the monthly AI credit allowance is the cap on every plan, and on AI Free it is 3 credits

identity_cost.detail: a JetBrains Account, created with an email address (one-time code, name and password) or a third-party login; JetBrains AI support says AI Free and AI Trial sign-up sometimes asks to link a payment card as a verification step with no charge, and the AI Pro trial asks to link a payment card; whether a card is asked for AI Free today is unverified: behind a sign-up, since the support article on it was last updated over a year before the read; AI Free is offered only in serviceable territories and inside a JetBrains IDE

reliability_note: the JetBrains AI service stopped serving China on 2026-07-13, and Junie CLI headless mode is described on its own page as an early access program
confidence_note: plans, credit counts, prices, agents, headless flags, sign-up steps and the card step are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02; Junie's JetBrains-account login in headless mode, Central CLI access for an AI Free licence, credits per task, and the current AI Free card prompt are unverified
